questions.text: If [latex]\int_{0}^{2\pi}|x sinx| dx=k \pi[/latex], then the value of k is equal to _______.
questions.solution:
On [latex][0,\pi][/latex], [latex]x\sin x\ge0[/latex]; on [latex][\pi,2\pi][/latex], [latex]x\sin x\le0[/latex]. Antiderivative of [latex]x\sin x[/latex] is [latex]\sin x-x\cos x[/latex].

- [latex]\int_0^{\pi}x\sin x\,dx=\pi[/latex]
- [latex]-\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}x\sin x\,dx=-[(0-2\pi)-(0+\pi)]=3\pi[/latex]

Total = [latex]4\pi[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] k = 4

Answer: 4

questions.text:
Consider the following minterm expression for F.
F(P,Q,R,S) = [latex]\Sigma[/latex] 0, 2, 5, 7, 8, 10, 13, 15
The minterms 2, 7, 8 and 13 are 'do not care terms. The minimal sum of-products form for F is
questions.solution:
Minterms 0, 5, 10, 15 with don't cares 2, 7, 8, 13.

- [latex]\bar Q\bar S[/latex] = {0, 2, 8, 10} covers 0, 10
- [latex]QS[/latex] = {5, 7, 13, 15} covers 5, 15

[latex]F=\bar Q\bar S+QS[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\bar Q\bar S+QS[/latex]

questions.text:
Consider the following processors (ns stands for nanoseconds). Assume that the pipeline registers have zero latency.
P1: Four-stage pipeline with stage latencies 1 ns, 2 ns, 2 ns, 1 ns.
P2: Four-stage pipeline with stage latencies 1 ns, 1.5 ns, 1.5 ns, 1.5 ns.
P3: Five-stage pipeline with stage latencies 0.5 ns, 1 ns, 1 ns, 0.6 ns, 1 ns.
P4: Five-stage pipeline with stage latencies 0.5 ns, 0.5 ns, 1 ns, 1 ns, 1.1 ns.
Which processor has the highest peak clock frequency?
questions.solution:
Clock period = largest stage latency.

- P1: 2 ns [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0.5 GHz
- P2: 1.5 ns [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0.67 GHz
- P3: 1 ns [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 1 GHz
- P4: 1.1 ns [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0.91 GHz

Answer: P3
